prompts.south:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE two-frame game sprite sheet, 2048x1024, two equal 1024x1024 cells SIDE BY SIDE. Image 1 is the existing wall MATERIAL/STYLE reference, image 2 gate timber reference. Create a matching robust rustic double-leaf wooden palisade GATE, high-angle top-down 2.5D hand-painted game art, sharp detailed brown bark, warm golden worn cut oak, rope lashings, a few subtle black iron hinges. Must blend exactly with reference wall. Transparent alpha background, no terrain, no floor, no scenery, no text, no labels, no UI, no white border. All edges inside cell. Camera fixed; vertical posts remain upright.
The gate orientation in screen space is: almost horizontal, the right hinge is 6 percent higher than the left hinge. Ground contact centres left (340,740), right (690,710) within EACH 1024x1024 cell.
LEFT CELL: CLOSED double gate. Two thick fixed hinge posts, two five-log solid leaves meet at centre; uneven broken/chopped tops, 2 heavy horizontal rails and diagonal timber braces; substantial defendable timber. Post height about 270 pixels, leaf height about 240 pixels. No arch or lintel.
RIGHT CELL: EXACT SAME gate OPEN, both leaves folded back almost 180 degrees alongside the adjacent wall line, extending OUTWARD beyond their hinge posts, leaving the entire original passage EMPTY and transparent. Show reverse-side rails and hinges naturally. The two fixed posts must have IDENTICAL silhouettes, scale, light, and pixel coordinates WITHIN THEIR CELL across BOTH frames. No morphing, squashing, warping. Same frame dimensions, camera, ground registration, lighting. Only the leaf states differ. These are two functional asset images for instant state swapping, not a concept presentation. Preserve authentic thick solid timber and reference painterly finish. Do not add extra wall sections, only the gate and its own two posts.
prompts.west: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is the EXACT GEOMETRY reference for a gate seen nearly EDGE ON from a high game camera. Create a two-frame transparent sprite sheet with two identical-sized portrait cells SIDE BY SIDE. Left cell: improve this SAME gate's skinny central leaves to be solid rough oak logs with rails, ropes and a few hinges, in the same detailed painterly game style. Right cell: the SAME gate OPEN, leaves parked to the sides of their hinge posts, leaving the passage clear. CRITICAL: Keep the hinge posts at EXACTLY the same screen coordinates in each cell as this reference: BACK post near upper middle, FRONT post nearly directly BELOW and slightly RIGHT. This is a NORTH-SOUTH wall, not a left-to-right wall! The posts are one behind the other, NOT side by side. Do not change camera. Maintain substantial side thickness on the logs. In open cell, keep both posts unchanged with the same feet and tops, and show the swung open leaves going LEFT and RIGHT from the respective posts. Do not show a front-facing gate. No terrain, no extra posts, no captions, no centre dividing line. Genuinely transparent background. Both states aligned for sprite swapping. Use whole canvas portrait dimensions for each cell and preserve current post proportions.
prompts.northwest: Use case: precise-object-edit. EXACT CAMERA AND PLACEMENT REFERENCE attached. Create one two-frame transparent game sprite sheet, TWO SAME-SIZE CELLS SIDE BY SIDE. LEFT CELL: repaint this SAME gate in the EXACT same diagonal perspective, same hinge-post foot positions and height, but make the gate leaves much thicker and solid like the chunky log posts. Weathered golden oak, broken spikes, bark, ropes, timber braces, restrained iron hinges, detailed painterly game style. RIGHT CELL: SAME gate OPEN. Both leaves parked next to their own hinge post, leaving the passage empty. NO terrain, NO extra wall sections, NO divider, NO text. True transparent background. This is a matched closed/open functional sprite, not a presentation. All artwork fits comfortably within each cell. Camera angle is locked to the attached reference.
